**Held for the maintainer — this seat will not merge it.** From the dispatching `domain:devx` PM seat (`session_01F8q5J1MQyocgtNspb15fSn`). This PR edits `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md`, which governs this seat's own behaviour, so self-review-and-merge is prohibited. Marked ready for review; **auto-merge deliberately not enabled.** CI is green (ESLint and TypeScript Type Check both read as job conclusions; `mergeable_state` clean).

**Ruling on the open question: option A — keep the ninth entry.**

It is a maintainer ruling (the 03:35Z wave/compaction decision, superseding the 03:31Z rotation draft) that currently lives only in a comment thread on a card about to close. This file's own step 1 says a ruling that lives only in a comment is a ruling the next reader skips — and entry 3 of this very PR exists to stop exactly that. Dropping it to honour the dispatch order's word "eight" would preserve a number at the cost of losing the ruling. If you disagree, the dev notes it is one contiguous block in step 9 and lifts out cleanly.

**Three things in this PR corrected upstream errors rather than inheriting them** — worth knowing before review, since two of the corrections are to instructions this seat gave:

1. **The dispatch order was wrong about the file's recent history.** It said `SKILL.md` changed twice tonight (#6871, #6886). The log shows five (#6871, #6886, #6959, #6911, #6974). The dev re-read the whole file instead of diffing against the two it was told about.
2. **Two of the card's own claims were re-verified and corrected before being written down** — the gate-list prescription ("enumerate from `lint.yml`") is wrong today, because 61 `pnpm check:*` invocations are in `lint.yml` and 7 are not (`ci.yml`, `spec-liveness-check.yml`, `validate-deps.yml`, `release.yml`, `showcase-smoke.yml`), so the landed text gives a command across all workflows rather than a filename; and #6668 is a PR, not an issue.
3. **The `ADR-0123` CI red was traced to its source rather than silenced.** The number came from the title of PR #6668, which closed unmerged, so it was never issued. Fixed by dropping the citation and stating the fact that makes it wrong — explicitly **not** by adding an allowlist entry (that list is shrink-only and its own header says adding to it is never the fix for a red build), and **not** by writing `docs/adr/0123-*.md`, which would have made this PR unmergeable by this seat under #6741.

⚠️ **One finding from this task deserves your attention independently of this PR: #7055.** `.claude/agents/os-dev.md:150` prescribes `git worktree remove <path> --force`. That is the root cause of a safety warning another dev tripped earlier tonight — it was following its own agent definition, not improvising. `--force` suppresses the refusal that protects a parallel agent's uncommitted work and the branch's own unpushed commits. The flag is not gratuitous (a worktree that ran `pnpm install` carries untracked `node_modules`, and the unforced form refuses), so the finding names the direction that keeps the guard armed: drop `node_modules` first, then remove unforced. This dev verified that sequence exits 0 in this very task.
